gen-gf-hedvig-letters-serif-gf-lexend-me: Lexend Mega reads like one thin steel rod bent into every letter, with a visible gap at the mouth of each c. Hedvig Letters Serif leads above it with a lightly shaded stroke, so the body text can stay modest in size.
gen-gf-hedvig-letters-serif-gf-lexend-pe: Wide-mouthed and sturdy, Lexend Peta draws its curves without any thinning, like a laser-etched line. Hedvig Letters Serif above it keeps a literary hand, its strokes varying just enough to feel alive, so a long page moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-hedvig-letters-serif-gf-lexend-te: Hedvig Letters Serif has an unusually large lowercase eye and the mild thick and thin of a dip pen used gently. Lexend Tera's spaced-out, uniform tubing is the stronger half.
gen-gf-hedvig-letters-serif-gf-lexend-ze: Lexend Zetta lays down ribbon-like strokes of one fixed width, tall in the small letters and widely tracked across the line. Hedvig Letters Serif gives sturdy hairlines and character; the sans simply keeps things moving.
gen-gf-hedvig-letters-serif-gf-montserra: Montserrat Alternates reads like a fineliner on paper, round and open, with lowercase that crowds up toward the capital line. And Hedvig Letters Serif, with its mellow thick-thin shift and generous lowercase eye, softens that crispness into something more literary.
gen-gf-hi-melody-fs-bespoke-serif: Hi Melody puts a hand-drawn, plain stripe of ink on the page, its glyphs huddled close like pressed-together tiles. But Bespoke Serif brings a faint thick-thin shift beneath it, a dignified counterweight that is not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-iansui-archivo: Friendly, hand-drawn and a touch wobbly, Iansui keeps its diagonals as thick as its uprights and lets its curve ends flare gently. Archivo brings the tall lowercase and outward-opening curves that make this pairing feel confident.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-asap: Asap reads in open arcs, with a lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals and keeps its text easy to follow. And Iansui, handwritten, is best at curves that never thin out at the turns, while Asap is best at staying quiet.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-bespoke-serif: Friendly and personal, Iansui looks hand-drawn. It does its best work with dowel-like stems and bent-dowel arcs, and then Bespoke Serif follows with strokes that vary in weight only slightly, good for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-epilogue: Personal and friendly, Iansui sets a handwritten tone up top. Epilogue sits beneath with its wire-like monoline skeleton and tall-bodied lowercase, so a moderate heading height meets a taller, stubbier body.
